evidence.title: Annual Report and Consolidated Financial Statements for 2025
evidence.excerpt: EcoDataCenter's audited 2025 annual report separately names Borlänge Data Centers B1 and B2, says work to build both began in 2025, and reports only their combined future capacity.

metadata.status_scope: The audited management report separately names Data Centers B1 and B2 and explicitly says work on building both began during 2025. Each sibling source therefore receives its own generic under_construction observation as of the December 31, 2025 balance-sheet date. The statement does not establish an exact start day or month or a finer clearing, civil, foundations, shell, MEP, energization, or commissioning stage.
metadata.phase_identity_scope: Data Center B1 and Data Center B2 are preserved as distinct project identities under one Borlänge campus. They are not collapsed into a B1/B2 aggregate project, treated as interchangeable phases, or counted as separate campuses.
metadata.capacity_guardrail: The report labels 24 MW only as the combined capacity of B1 and B2 upon commissioning. It does not type the figure as critical IT, gross facility, grid connection, generation, current draw, or annual energy. The forward-looking combined value remains shared evidence metadata only and is not split, divided, duplicated, or allocated to either project.
metadata.adjacent_land_guardrail: A separate property note says construction had not begun on newly acquired land intended for another data center as of the reporting date. That adjacent expansion is not identified as B1 or B2 and does not contradict, supersede, or create a lifecycle row for the management report's explicitly named B1 and B2 builds.
metadata.role_scope: The report says EcoDataCenter designs, builds, and operates data centers and identifies EcoDC Borlänge AB and EcoDC 2 Fastighets AB as working on the Borlänge facility and development. This supports EcoDataCenter as developer and intended operator for the campus and both unfinished projects, but not Areim, a legal subsidiary, a contractor, or any other party as owner, operator, or tenant.
metadata.locality_scope: The management report explicitly locates Data Centers B1 and B2 at the Borlänge site. It does not establish a street address, parcel, point, footprint, coordinates, geometry, or unique-site assertion. The parent company's Slaggvarpsvägen head-office address is not used as the Borlänge campus address.
metadata.other_project_guardrail: Falun Data Centers C, D, E, and F, the Östersund cancellation, and later development on newly acquired Borlänge land are outside this source record and create no entity, lifecycle, capacity, or operating fact here.
metadata.classification_guardrail: General AI demand, customer-selection, service, and digital-infrastructure language is not specific to Data Center B1 or B2 and creates no workload, tenant, customer, user, installed-hardware, accelerator, server, model, or operating-model observation.
metadata.energy_generation_guardrail: Generic renewable-electricity, hydro, wind, heat-recovery, backup-power, and fuel-powered-generator disclosures are not project-specific and create no grid connection, gross demand, generation nameplate, current draw, annual energy, measured consumption, PUE, WUE, renewable-share, cooling, heat-export, or emissions observation for B1 or B2.
